title: Give It Away
goal: The team stores the member. Sometimes the right move IS a move — 0 clones.
hints: The borrow-then-to_owned version works… but who really needs to own the name?
main never uses name after the call. Let register take the String itself and push it straight in.
explanation: The starting code borrows and then buys ownership back with to_owned() — an allocation for nothing. Because main never touches `name` afterwards, the clean design moves ownership INTO register: `String` parameter, push `member` directly, zero copies. The opposite lesson of Use It Twice: borrowing is the default, but when the callee stores the value, transfer it.
